description: Routes one of four inputs to the output, choosing a new one at random on each trigger

params.text: Picks which of the four inputs is favoured, or uniform randomness for no favourite
Sets how often the favoured input is chosen, 0 to 100%; the rest of the time one of the other three is chosen

inputs.text: A trigger chooses a new input to route to the output
One of the four signals the output can be routed from, gates or voltages alike

outputs.text: Carries whichever input is currently chosen

notes: the chosen input does not change until a trigger arrives at the TRG input.
